justification: Lists the member headers of 7z archives for archive_listing (P365 c5). Optional and imported dynamically: without it 7z archives are reported with their signature-header facts and an INFO 'member listing needs the optional py7zr extra' finding; nothing is ever extracted through it.
notes: Batch p1-G12-1. LGPL used unmodified as an optional pip dependency (A6); pycdlib (UDF-only images) and rarfile are not wired in this build (own RAR header parser).
